aggregation_stories.title: Your CRM Was Built for a World Before AI. That’s Why Your Agents Keep Failing
aggregation_stories.summary: Many agentic AI projects fail not because of the AI models themselves, but due to incomplete, inaccurate, and unstructured data within CRM systems. CRM platforms were designed for human interpretation, allowing for inference and gap-filling, which AI agents cannot do. This fundamental mismatch between how CRMs store data and what AI needs for automated reasoning leads to underperformance and project cancellations.
